Module com.example.miniproyecto_batalla_naval
Package com.example.miniproyecto_batalla_naval.controller

Class PlacementController

java.lang.Object
com.example.miniproyecto_batalla_naval.controller.PlacementController
All Implemented Interfaces:
CellInteractionListener, RotationListener
public class PlacementController extends Object implements CellInteractionListener, RotationListener
Controller responsible for the ship placement stage of the Battleship game. Manages fleet placement, ship rotation, placement preview, and the transition from the placement phase to the main gameplay screen. Implements both CellInteractionListener and RotationListener to respond to board interactions and keyboard rotation events.

  • Method Details

    • startNewGame

      public void startNewGame(String nickname)
      Initializes a new placement session for the specified player. Creates the board, prepares the pending fleet, builds the visual grid, enables the hover preview, and configures the initial interface state.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the nickname entered by the player

    • loadPendingShips

      private void loadPendingShips()
      Loads the fleet that must be placed by the player. Ships are inserted into the queue following the official order established for the game.

    • handleRotate

      private void handleRotate()
      Rotates the orientation of the ship currently waiting to be placed. If the mouse is positioned over the board, the ghost preview is immediately updated to reflect the new orientation.

    • handleStartGame

      private void handleStartGame()
      Creates the game model once the fleet has been placed. Generates the machine player, places its fleet automatically, creates the complete game model, and opens the gameplay screen.

    • onRotateRequested

      public void onRotateRequested()
      Invoked when a ship rotation is requested. This method is typically triggered by a keyboard event, such as pressing the Space key during the ship placement phase. Handles a rotation request generated from the keyboard by delegating the action to the controller's rotation logic.
      Specified by:
      onRotateRequested in interface RotationListener

    • onCellLeftClick

      public void onCellLeftClick(int row, int column)
      Invoked when the user performs a left-click on a board cell. Attempts to place the current ship at the selected board position.
      Specified by:
      onCellLeftClick in interface CellInteractionListener
      Parameters:
      row - the row index of the selected cell
      column - the column index of the selected cell

    • onCellRightClick

      public void onCellRightClick(int row, int column)
      Invoked when the user performs a right-click on a board cell. Rotates the current ship when the user performs a right-click on the placement board.
      Specified by:
      onCellRightClick in interface CellInteractionListener
      Parameters:
      row - the row index of the selected cell
      column - the column index of the selected cell

    • placeCurrentShip

      private void placeCurrentShip(int row, int column)
      Attempts to place the next pending ship on the board. If the placement is valid, the ship is drawn, removed from the pending queue, and the interface is updated accordingly. Otherwise, the validation message is displayed to the player.
      Parameters:
      row - the row where the ship placement begins
      column - the column where the ship placement begins

    • paintShip

      private void paintShip(Ship ship)
      Draws the specified ship on the placement board. Each occupied cell is represented using the corresponding graphical segment according to the ship's size, orientation, and position within the vessel.
      Parameters:
      ship - the ship to be rendered on the board

    • attachHoverPreview

      private void attachHoverPreview()
      Registers the mouse listeners required to display the ghost ship preview. The preview follows the cursor while it remains inside the board and is automatically removed when the cursor leaves the placement area.

    • showGhostShip

      private void showGhostShip(int anchorRow, int anchorColumn)
      Displays a preview of the next ship to be placed. The preview is rendered using green or red ghost cells depending on whether the current placement is valid according to the board state and the selected orientation.
      Parameters:
      anchorRow - the row where the preview begins
      anchorColumn - the column where the preview begins

    • clearGhostShip

      private void clearGhostShip()
      Removes the current ghost ship preview from the board. All temporary graphical nodes associated with the preview are deleted from their corresponding cells.

    • updateCurrentShipLabel

      private void updateCurrentShipLabel()
      Updates the label that indicates which ship must be placed next. If all ships have already been placed, a placeholder is displayed.

    • translateShipType

      private String translateShipType(ShipType type)
      Returns the Spanish name corresponding to the specified ship type.
      Parameters:
      type - the ship type to translate
      Returns:
      the localized name of the ship type
